ABSTRACT. This paper gives an explicit zero-free region
           for the Riemann zeta-function derived from the Vinogradov-
           Korobov method. We prove that the Riemann zeta-function
           does not vanish in the region σ ≥ 1 − .00105 log−2/3 |t|
           (log log |t|)−1/3 and |t| ≥ 3.
